Profound Sounds

$1,699 up to 4 hours

Austin wedding DJ company also working in New York, with DJ and emcee service, lighting, a photo booth, and optional classical musicians.

The Moment is $1,699 for up to 4 hours of reception-only coverage with a DJ, planning portal, sound, and a wireless microphone. Longer ceremony-to-reception packages on the same page are $2,999, $3,599, $4,499, and $5,999. · Source · checked 2026-10-03 · published
